subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body:
4/5 — following up on the two $89 entries on packet packet WC-12. When I called the packet scanner, they said the second entry isn't a normal authorization hold — it's connected to a review that's already open on my account, which is why it hasn't released.

the packet scanner gave me their merchant-reconciliation reference and explained that their response has to go through the merchant's dispute record rather than a requester message, because the reply email isn't read by their system at all. The record is filed in the reply but processed automatically on their side. Can you file the dispute response on the onboarding ticket HD-4471 with the account review reference from the onboarding record, so it reaches their system and the hold can be reconciled? The reference is the label on my own account case, not the internal scoring logic behind it.
